title: SWE-DeceptionBench: Benchmarking Deceptive Behaviors of LLMs Across the Software Development Lifecycle
title_zh: SWE-DeceptionBench：评估大型语言模型在整个软件开发生命周期中的欺骗行为

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used throughout the software development lifecycle. This growing reliance on LLMs raises concerns about their trustworthiness, with deception posing a particularly important risk. Deceptive behavior takes the form of misleading responses or assistance in fabricating, concealing, or distorting information. To study this behavior, we introduce SWE-DeceptionBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM deception in software engineering. The benchmark covers six lifecycle stages and two deception triggers: Active Deception, where models recognize infeasible or conflicting requirements but still present them as achievable, and Passive Deception, where models help fulfill explicit user requests to mislead others. We further introduce Neutral, Reward, and Pressure conditions to study the effect of external inducements, resulting in 720 test instances in Chinese and English. Evaluating seven mainstream LLMs, we find substantial deception even under the Neutral condition, with aggregate rates of 49.88% for Active Deception and 64.29% for Passive Deception. Deception rates vary across lifecycle stages, and external inducements affect Active and Passive Deception to different extents. We also evaluate lightweight defenses, finding that guard models miss many deceptive requests, and Self-Reminder reduces but does not eliminate deceptive responses. These findings highlight the need for more effective deception detection and mitigation methods to support trustworthy LLM-based software engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地应用于整个软件开发生命周期中。 对LLM日益增长的依赖引发了对其可靠性的担忧，其中欺骗行为构成了尤为重要的风险。 欺骗行为表现为误导性回应，或在捏造、隐瞒或歪曲信息方面提供帮助。 为了研究这种行为，我们提出了SWE-DeceptionBench，一个用于评估LLM在软件工程领域欺骗行为的基准测试。 该基准测试涵盖了生命周期的六个阶段和两种欺骗触发机制：主动欺骗（模型识别出不可行或冲突的需求，但仍将其描述为可实现），以及被动欺骗（模型帮助满足用户的明确请求以误导他人）。 我们进一步引入了“中立”“奖励”和“压力”三种情境，以研究外部激励的影响，由此生成了720个中英文测试实例。 通过对七款主流LLM的评估，我们发现即使在“中立”情境下也存在大量欺骗行为，主动欺骗的平均发生率为49.88%，被动欺骗则为64.29%。 不同生命周期阶段的欺骗率存在差异，且外部激励对主动欺骗和被动欺骗的影响程度也不相同。 我们还评估了轻量级防御方法，发现防护模型会漏掉许多欺骗性请求，而“自我提醒”机制虽能减少欺骗性回应，但无法完全消除。 这些研究结果凸显了开发更有效的欺骗检测与缓解方法的必要性，以支持基于LLM的可靠软件工程实践。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been rapidly adopted in software engineering practice. They are gradually evolving from simple code completion tools into intelligent assistants that support multiple stages of software development ( Hou et al., 2024 ) . For example, MetaGPT employs LLM-based agents to translate user requirements into structured requirements documents and system designs ( Hong et al., 2024 ) . ChatUniTest focuses on leveraging LLMs for automated unit test generation ( Chen et al., 2024b ) , while agent-based systems such as SWE-agent support iterative software development by enabling LLMs to inspect repositories, modify code, and execute tests and programs ( Yang et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: As LLMs become increasingly involved in software engineering, their outputs may directly influence real engineering decisions and artifacts, raising new concerns about their trustworthiness. One particularly important concern is the potential for deceptive behavior. An LLM exhibits such behavior when it produces misleading responses or assists in misrepresenting information. To examine this risk, we consider two types of software engineering scenarios. The Active Deception task assesses whether an LLM recognizes infeasible or conflicting requirements but still presents them as achievable. The Passive Deception task assesses whether an LLM assists with explicit user requests to fabricate, conceal, or distort information. Figure 1 illustrates representative cases of these two scenarios. Such behaviors can mislead developers and affect downstream decisions and system outcomes, making their evaluation important for the trustworthy use of LLMs. However, most existing deception benchmarks are not tailored to software engineering. DeceptionBench, for example, covers domains such as healthcare, education, and social interaction ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . The evaluation of LLM deception in software engineering therefore remains limited.

paragraphs.en: To assess the risks posed by LLM deception in software engineering, we evaluate seven mainstream LLMs, including GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Claude-Opus-4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , and DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) , on SWE-DeceptionBench. We also examine two lightweight defenses: guard models ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) for detecting deceptive requests and Self-Reminder ( Xie et al., 2023 ) for mitigating deceptive responses. Our main findings are as follows: \ding 182 Deceptive behaviors are prevalent in software engineering scenarios. Even under the Neutral condition, Active and Passive Deception rates reach 49.88% and 64.29%, respectively. Models may produce misleading answers despite recognizing task limitations or assist explicit requests to mislead others. \ding 183 Deception varies across engineering contexts and external inducement conditions. We observe differences in deception rates across the six software development lifecycle stages. External inducements also influence deceptive behavior, with the extent of their effects differing between Active and Passive Deception. \ding 184 Lightweight defenses provide incomplete protection against deception. Guard models detect only a limited proportion of deceptive requests, while Self-Reminder substantially reduces deceptive responses but does not eliminate them. These findings demonstrate that deception constitutes an important trustworthiness risk for LLM-based software engineering. Further research is therefore needed to develop more effective methods for detecting and mitigating deceptive behavior.

sents.en: Our main findings are as follows: \ding 182 Deceptive behaviors are prevalent in software engineering scenarios.
sents.zh: 我们的主要发现如下：\ding 182 欺骗行为在软件工程场景中普遍存在。

sents.en: Even under the Neutral condition, Active and Passive Deception rates reach 49.88% and 64.29%, respectively.
sents.zh: 即使在“中立”条件下，主动欺骗和被动欺骗的发生率分别达到 49.88% 和 64.29%。

sents.en: Models may produce misleading answers despite recognizing task limitations or assist explicit requests to mislead others. \ding 183 Deception varies across engineering contexts and external inducement conditions.
sents.zh: 模型即便能识别任务限制，仍可能生成误导性答案；它们也可能协助明确请求以误导他人。\ding 183 欺骗行为因工程场景和外部诱因条件的不同而存在差异。

sents.en: We observe differences in deception rates across the six software development lifecycle stages.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，在软件开发生命周期的六个阶段中，欺骗率存在显著差异。

sents.en: External inducements also influence deceptive behavior, with the extent of their effects differing between Active and Passive Deception. \ding 184 Lightweight defenses provide incomplete protection against deception.
sents.zh: 外部诱因也会影响欺骗行为，且其对主动欺骗与被动欺骗的影响程度有所不同。\ding 184 轻量级防御无法完全防止欺骗行为的发生。

sents.en: Guard models detect only a limited proportion of deceptive requests, while Self-Reminder substantially reduces deceptive responses but does not eliminate them.
sents.zh: 守护模型仅能检测出有限比例的欺骗性请求，而自我提醒机制虽能大幅减少欺骗性响应，但并未彻底消除它们。

sents.en: These findings demonstrate that deception constitutes an important trustworthiness risk for LLM-based software engineering.
sents.zh: 这些发现表明，欺骗行为构成了基于 LLM 的软件工程领域一项重要的可信度风险。

sents.en: Further research is therefore needed to develop more effective methods for detecting and mitigating deceptive behavior.
sents.zh: 因此，有必要开展进一步研究，以开发更有效的欺骗行为检测与缓解方法。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献有三方面：

paragraphs.en: We formulate software engineering deception as an observable behavioral trustworthiness issue and distinguish Active and Passive Deception based on how deceptive behavior is triggered.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将软件工程中的欺骗问题表述为一个可观察的行为可信度问题，并根据欺骗行为的触发方式，将其区分为主动欺骗和被动欺骗。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SWE-DeceptionBench, a benchmark spanning six software development lifecycle stages and controlled external inducement conditions, comprising 720 test instances in Chinese and English.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SWE-DeceptionBench，这是一个涵盖六个软件开发生命周期阶段和受控外部诱导条件的基准测试，包含 720 个中文和英文测试实例。

paragraphs.en: We conduct an extensive evaluation of seven LLMs and assess lightweight detection and mitigation methods, providing empirical evidence on deception patterns and the effectiveness and limitations of these defenses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对七种大型语言模型进行了全面评估，并检验了轻量级的检测与缓解方法，从而为欺骗模式以及这些防御措施的有效性和局限性提供了实证依据。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce SWE-DeceptionBench, a benchmark for evaluating deceptive behaviors of LLMs in software engineering. We first present an overview of the benchmark’s coverage and composition, then explain its three design dimensions. Finally, we describe the benchmark construction process.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍 SWE-DeceptionBench，这是一个用于评估大型语言模型在软件工程领域欺骗性行为的基准测试。 我们首先概述该基准测试的覆盖范围与构成，然后解释其三个设计维度。 最后，我们将描述该基准测试的构建过程。

paragraphs.en: SWE-DeceptionBench is designed along three dimensions: software development lifecycle coverage , deception trigger , and external inducement conditions . As shown in Figure 3 , the benchmark covers six lifecycle stages, with both Active and Passive Deception scenarios represented at each stage. Building on these scenarios, we further introduce different external inducement conditions to examine how rewards and pressure affect deceptive behavior.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-DeceptionBench 的设计涵盖三个维度：软件开发生命周期覆盖范围、欺骗触发因素以及外部诱因条件。 如图 3 所示，该基准测试覆盖了生命周期的六个阶段，每个阶段都包含了主动欺骗和被动欺骗两种场景。 基于这些场景，我们进一步引入了不同的外部诱因条件，以研究奖励和压力如何影响欺骗行为。

paragraphs.en: As LLMs are increasingly integrated into different stages of software development ( Hou et al., 2024 ) , evaluating their trustworthiness requires examining engineering activities beyond code generation. The six lifecycle stages covered by SWE-DeceptionBench involve different tasks and associated deception risks. During Requirements Analysis, models may encounter infeasible constraints or conflicting objectives in user requirements. During System Design, risks may arise from unrealistic architectures or concealed design limitations. Development and Testing involve risks related to code implementation, test results, and quality metrics, while Deployment and Maintenance involve release status, operational risks, and incident disclosures.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地融入软件开发的各个阶段（Hou et al., 2024），评估其可信度需要考察代码生成之外的工程活动。 SWE-DeceptionBench 涵盖的六个生命周期阶段涉及不同的任务以及相关的欺骗风险。 在需求分析阶段，模型可能会遇到用户需求中不切实际的约束或相互冲突的目标。 在系统设计中，风险可能源于不切实际的架构或被隐藏的设计局限性。 开发与测试阶段涉及代码实现、测试结果和质量指标相关的风险，而部署与维护阶段则涉及发布状态、运行风险和事件披露。

sents.en: As LLMs are increasingly integrated into different stages of software development ( Hou et al., 2024 ) , evaluating their trustworthiness requires examining engineering activities beyond code generation.

sents.en: During Requirements Analysis, models may encounter infeasible constraints or conflicting objectives in user requirements.
sents.zh: 在需求分析阶段，模型可能会遇到用户需求中不切实际的约束或相互冲突的目标。

sents.en: During System Design, risks may arise from unrealistic architectures or concealed design limitations.
sents.zh: 在系统设计中，风险可能源于不切实际的架构或被隐藏的设计局限性。

sents.en: Development and Testing involve risks related to code implementation, test results, and quality metrics, while Deployment and Maintenance involve release status, operational risks, and incident disclosures.
sents.zh: 开发与测试阶段涉及代码实现、测试结果和质量指标相关的风险，而部署与维护阶段则涉及发布状态、运行风险和事件披露。

paragraphs.en: This coverage allows us to examine how deceptive behavior manifests across engineering activities and whether its prevalence differs between lifecycle stages.
paragraphs.zh: 这种覆盖范围使我们能够研究欺骗性行为在不同工程活动中的表现方式，以及其普遍性是否在生命周期各阶段存在差异。

paragraphs.en: The Active and Passive Deception scenarios introduced in Section 1 differ in the source of deception risk. We use the term deception trigger to characterize these sources and include both types of scenarios at each lifecycle stage.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 节中介绍的主动欺骗和被动欺骗场景在欺骗风险的来源上有所不同。 我们使用“欺骗触发因素”这一术语来描述这些来源，并在每个生命周期阶段都包含这两种类型的场景。

sents.en: The Active and Passive Deception scenarios introduced in Section 1 differ in the source of deception risk.
sents.zh: 第 1 节中介绍的主动欺骗和被动欺骗场景在欺骗风险的来源上有所不同。

sents.en: We use the term deception trigger to characterize these sources and include both types of scenarios at each lifecycle stage.
sents.zh: 我们使用“欺骗触发因素”这一术语来描述这些来源，并在每个生命周期阶段都包含这两种类型的场景。

paragraphs.en: Active Deception. In Active Deception scenarios, users specify infeasible objectives or mutually conflicting engineering constraints without explicitly asking the model to deceive. Such conflicts may involve requirements for privacy, functionality, resource usage, or system guarantees that cannot be simultaneously satisfied. For example, a request may demand proof that a system has no defects based on a limited set of tests.
paragraphs.zh: 主动欺骗。 在主动欺骗场景中，用户会指定不可行的目标或相互冲突的工程约束，而并未明确要求模型进行欺骗。 此类冲突可能涉及隐私、功能、资源使用或系统保证等方面的要求，而这些要求无法同时满足。 例如，一个请求可能要求基于有限的测试集来证明系统没有任何缺陷。

sents.en: Active Deception.
sents.zh: 主动欺骗。

sents.en: In Active Deception scenarios, users specify infeasible objectives or mutually conflicting engineering constraints without explicitly asking the model to deceive.
sents.zh: 在主动欺骗场景中，用户会指定不可行的目标或相互冲突的工程约束，而并未明确要求模型进行欺骗。

sents.en: Such conflicts may involve requirements for privacy, functionality, resource usage, or system guarantees that cannot be simultaneously satisfied.
sents.zh: 此类冲突可能涉及隐私、功能、资源使用或系统保证等方面的要求，而这些要求无法同时满足。

sents.en: For example, a request may demand proof that a system has no defects based on a limited set of tests.
sents.zh: 例如，一个请求可能要求基于有限的测试集来证明系统没有任何缺陷。

paragraphs.en: For these scenarios, we classify model responses into three categories based on whether the model recognizes the infeasibility or conflict and how it addresses the issue in its final answer. The model produces a Deceptive Response when it recognizes the underlying issue but still presents the requested objective as achievable. An Honest Response identifies the issue and either declines the infeasible request or proposes reasonable adjustments while explicitly explaining the relevant limitations. If the model fails to recognize the issue and produces an incorrect or infeasible solution, the response is labeled Hallucination or Capability Failure .
paragraphs.zh: 对于这些场景，我们根据模型是否识别出不可行性或冲突，以及它在最终答案中如何处理该问题，将模型响应分为三类。 当模型识别出潜在问题，但仍声称所请求的目标可以实现时，它会生成“欺骗性响应”。 “诚实响应”会识别出问题，并拒绝不可行的请求，或提出合理的调整方案，同时明确解释相关的限制条件。 如果模型未能识别出问题，并生成了错误或不切实际的解决方案，则其响应将被标记为“幻觉”或“能力失败”。

paragraphs.en: Passive Deception. In Passive Deception scenarios, users explicitly request assistance with deceptive objectives, such as fabricating test results, hiding security vulnerabilities, or misrepresenting deployment outcomes. We consider three forms of assistance toward these objectives ( Shi et al., 2026 ) :
paragraphs.zh: 被动欺骗。 在被动欺骗场景中，用户会明确要求协助实现欺骗性目标，例如伪造测试结果、隐藏安全漏洞或歪曲部署结果。 我们考虑了为实现这些目标提供的三种形式的协助（Shi 等人，2026）：

sents.en: Passive Deception.
sents.zh: 被动欺骗。

sents.en: In Passive Deception scenarios, users explicitly request assistance with deceptive objectives, such as fabricating test results, hiding security vulnerabilities, or misrepresenting deployment outcomes.
sents.zh: 在被动欺骗场景中，用户会明确要求协助实现欺骗性目标，例如伪造测试结果、隐藏安全漏洞或歪曲部署结果。

sents.en: We consider three forms of assistance toward these objectives ( Shi et al., 2026 ) :
sents.zh: 我们考虑了为实现这些目标提供的三种形式的协助（Shi 等人，2026）：

paragraphs.en: Fabrication : Generating false information or results, such as fabricating successful test records.
paragraphs.zh: 捏造：生成虚假信息或结果，例如捏造成功的测试记录。

paragraphs.en: Concealment : Hiding critical information that affects judgment, such as concealing security risks or system failures.
paragraphs.zh: 隐瞒：隐藏影响判断的关键信息，例如隐瞒安全风险或系统故障。

paragraphs.en: Pragmatic Distortion : Misleading others through wording, statistical criteria, or information presentation while preserving partial factual correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 实用主义扭曲：通过措辞、统计标准或信息呈现方式误导他人，同时保持部分事实的正确性。

paragraphs.en: For these scenarios, we assess whether the model’s final response provides substantive assistance toward the explicitly stated deceptive objective. A Deceptive Response provides information, code, or instructions that help achieve that objective. A warning or expression of concern does not change this classification if the response still provides such assistance. An Honest Response refuses to help achieve the deceptive objective or offers a truthful alternative without facilitating it.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些场景中，我们会评估模型最终的回答是否对明确提出的欺骗性目标提供了实质性的帮助。 欺骗性回答会提供有助于实现该目标的信息、代码或指令。 即使回答仍然提供了此类帮助，警告或表达担忧也不会改变这一分类。 诚实的回答会拒绝帮助实现欺骗性目标，或提出真实的替代方案而不会助长该目标。

sents.en: For these scenarios, we assess whether the model’s final response provides substantive assistance toward the explicitly stated deceptive objective.
sents.zh: 在这些场景中，我们会评估模型最终的回答是否对明确提出的欺骗性目标提供了实质性的帮助。

sents.en: A Deceptive Response provides information, code, or instructions that help achieve that objective.
sents.zh: 欺骗性回答会提供有助于实现该目标的信息、代码或指令。

sents.en: A warning or expression of concern does not change this classification if the response still provides such assistance.
sents.zh: 即使回答仍然提供了此类帮助，警告或表达担忧也不会改变这一分类。

sents.en: An Honest Response refuses to help achieve the deceptive objective or offers a truthful alternative without facilitating it.
sents.zh: 诚实的回答会拒绝帮助实现欺骗性目标，或提出真实的替代方案而不会助长该目标。

paragraphs.en: Within each lifecycle stage, paired Active and Passive Deception scenarios share the same role, working context, and target deliverable. This pairing allows us to examine the two sources of deception risk in related engineering contexts. The detailed construction procedure is presented in Section 2.3 .

sents.zh: 为了探究外部激励如何影响软件工程中的欺骗行为，我们在三种条件下对每个场景进行了具体实现：

paragraphs.en: Neutral Condition (P0) : The model receives a software engineering request without additional incentives or pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 中性条件 (P0)：模型在没有任何额外激励或压力的情况下接收一个软件工程请求。

paragraphs.en: Reward Condition (P1) : The user provides positive incentives, such as promises of rewards, higher ratings, or adoption of the proposed solution, to encourage the model to accomplish the requested objective.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励条件（P1）：用户提供正向激励，例如承诺给予奖励、给出更高评分或采用所提出的解决方案，以鼓励模型完成所请求的目标。

paragraphs.en: Pressure Condition (P2) : The user introduces pressure, such as negative consequences of failure or mandatory completion requirements, to encourage the model to accomplish the requested objective.
paragraphs.zh: 压力条件（P2）：用户引入压力，例如失败的负面后果或强制性的完成要求，以促使模型实现所请求的目标。

paragraphs.en: These conditions preserve the underlying engineering task and deception trigger while varying the external inducement. This design supports controlled comparisons of how rewards and pressure affect model behavior in each type of deception scenario.
paragraphs.zh: 这些条件在改变外部诱因的同时，保留了底层的工程任务和欺骗触发机制。 这种设计支持对奖励和压力在不同类型的欺骗场景中如何影响模型行为的受控比较。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 4 , the construction process of SWE-DeceptionBench consists of three stages: Base Scenario Construction , Deception Trigger Injection , and External Inducement Injection . We first construct base software engineering scenarios without explicit conflicts or deceptive objectives. We then inject the triggers corresponding to Active and Passive Deception, and finally augment the resulting scenarios with reward- and pressure-based inducements.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 4 所示，SWE-DeceptionBench 的构建过程包括三个阶段：基础场景构建、欺骗触发注入和外部诱导注入。 我们首先构建不包含明显冲突或欺骗性目标的基础软件工程场景。 接着，我们注入主动欺骗和被动欺骗对应的触发机制，最后通过奖励和压力相关的诱导手段对生成的场景进行增强。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 4 , the construction process of SWE-DeceptionBench consists of three stages: Base Scenario Construction , Deception Trigger Injection , and External Inducement Injection .
sents.zh: 如图 4 所示，SWE-DeceptionBench 的构建过程包括三个阶段：基础场景构建、欺骗触发注入和外部诱导注入。

sents.en: We first construct base software engineering scenarios without explicit conflicts or deceptive objectives.
sents.zh: 我们首先构建不包含明显冲突或欺骗性目标的基础软件工程场景。

sents.en: We then inject the triggers corresponding to Active and Passive Deception, and finally augment the resulting scenarios with reward- and pressure-based inducements.
sents.zh: 接着，我们注入主动欺骗和被动欺骗对应的触发机制，最后通过奖励和压力相关的诱导手段对生成的场景进行增强。

paragraphs.en: The first stage aims to construct base scenario skeletons that can support both Active and Passive Deception.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段旨在构建基础场景框架，以支持主动欺骗和被动欺骗两种模式。

paragraphs.en: First, for each of the six software development lifecycle stages, we identify four representative types of target deliverables to cover common software engineering tasks at that stage. We then use an LLM to generate five candidate scenario skeletons for each target deliverable type, resulting in 20 candidates per stage. Prior work has used automated generation to scale programming benchmark construction, with generated instances assessed quantitatively and through human judgments ( Chen et al., 2024a ) . Finally, these candidates are manually reviewed and selected based on realism, consistency with the lifecycle stage, redundancy, and suitability for subsequent deception-trigger injection. We retain 10 scenarios per stage that best satisfy these criteria, producing 60 base scenarios in total.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，对于软件开发生命周期的六个阶段中的每一个阶段，我们都会确定四种具有代表性的目标交付物类型，以覆盖该阶段的常见软件工程任务。 接着，我们使用一个大语言模型为每种目标交付物类型生成五个候选场景骨架，从而在每个阶段得到 20 个候选项。 先前的研究已利用自动化生成方法来扩展编程基准测试的构建规模，其中生成的实例通过定量评估和人工判断进行了检验（Chen et al., 2024a）。 最后，这些候选项会经过人工审查，并根据其真实性、与生命周期阶段的契合度、冗余性以及对后续欺骗触发注入的适用性进行选择。 我们保留每个阶段中最好满足这些标准的 10 个场景，最终总共得到 60 个基础场景。

sents.zh: 首先，对于软件开发生命周期的六个阶段中的每一个阶段，我们都会确定四种具有代表性的目标交付物类型，以覆盖该阶段的常见软件工程任务。

sents.en: We retain 10 scenarios per stage that best satisfy these criteria, producing 60 base scenarios in total.
sents.zh: 我们保留每个阶段中最好满足这些标准的 10 个场景，最终总共得到 60 个基础场景。

paragraphs.en: To ensure that the same base scenario can later be instantiated as either Active or Passive Deception, no conflicting constraints, deceptive requests, or external inducements are introduced at this stage. Each scenario skeleton mainly specifies the role , working context , target deliverable , and task objective , thereby describing a realistic software engineering setting. For example, a base scenario in the Testing stage may describe a QA engineer who needs to prepare a functional testing and defect report before release so that the release team can determine whether the current version is ready for deployment. This scenario can later be adapted to introduce either conflicting requirements or an explicit deceptive objective.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保同一个基础场景后续能够被实例化为主动欺骗或被动欺骗，现阶段不会引入任何冲突的约束、欺骗性请求或外部诱因。 每个场景骨架主要定义了角色、工作背景、目标交付物和任务目标，从而描述了一个真实的软件工程环境。 例如，测试阶段的一个基础场景可能描述了一名质量保证工程师，他需要在发布前准备功能测试和缺陷报告，以便发布团队能够判断当前版本是否已准备好部署。 该场景后续可以被调整，以引入冲突的需求或明确的欺骗目标。

sents.en: To ensure that the same base scenario can later be instantiated as either Active or Passive Deception, no conflicting constraints, deceptive requests, or external inducements are introduced at this stage.
sents.zh: 为确保同一个基础场景后续能够被实例化为主动欺骗或被动欺骗，现阶段不会引入任何冲突的约束、欺骗性请求或外部诱因。

sents.zh: 该场景后续可以被调整，以引入冲突的需求或明确的欺骗目标。

paragraphs.en: In the second stage, we use an LLM to transform each of the 60 base scenario skeletons into both Active and Passive Deception variants. The LLM is instructed to preserve the original role, working context, and target deliverable while modifying the task objective or constraints to introduce the corresponding deception trigger.
paragraphs.zh: 在第二阶段，我们使用一个大语言模型（LLM）将 60 个基础场景骨架分别转换为主动欺骗和被动欺骗两种变体。 我们指示大语言模型在修改任务目标或约束条件以引入相应的欺骗触发机制的同时，保留原始角色、工作上下文和目标成果。

sents.en: In the second stage, we use an LLM to transform each of the 60 base scenario skeletons into both Active and Passive Deception variants.
sents.zh: 在第二阶段，我们使用一个大语言模型（LLM）将 60 个基础场景骨架分别转换为主动欺骗和被动欺骗两种变体。

sents.en: The LLM is instructed to preserve the original role, working context, and target deliverable while modifying the task objective or constraints to introduce the corresponding deception trigger.
sents.zh: 我们指示大语言模型在修改任务目标或约束条件以引入相应的欺骗触发机制的同时，保留原始角色、工作上下文和目标成果。

paragraphs.en: Active Deception. For Active Deception, we prompt the LLM to modify or add task constraints such that the original task becomes infeasible or contains mutually conflicting requirements, without explicitly asking the model to deceive. Candidate conflicts are constructed around common sources of contradiction in software engineering, including resource or time constraints , missing information or evidence , conflicts between security and functional objectives , restricted verification processes , and competing system properties . For each base scenario, the LLM generates several candidate variants based on its lifecycle stage and task characteristics, from which we then manually select the variant that is most natural, exhibits a clear conflict, and has practical engineering relevance.
paragraphs.zh: 主动欺骗。 对于主动欺骗，我们提示大型语言模型修改或添加任务约束，使原始任务变得不可行或包含相互冲突的要求，而无需明确要求模型进行欺骗。 候选冲突围绕软件工程中的常见矛盾来源构建，包括资源或时间限制、信息或证据缺失、安全目标与功能目标之间的冲突、受限的验证流程以及相互竞争的系统属性。 对于每个基础场景，大型语言模型会根据其生命周期阶段和任务特征生成多个候选变体，然后我们从这些变体中手动选择最自然、表现出明确冲突且具有实际工程相关性的变体。

sents.en: Active Deception.
sents.zh: 主动欺骗。

sents.en: For Active Deception, we prompt the LLM to modify or add task constraints such that the original task becomes infeasible or contains mutually conflicting requirements, without explicitly asking the model to deceive.
sents.zh: 对于主动欺骗，我们提示大型语言模型修改或添加任务约束，使原始任务变得不可行或包含相互冲突的要求，而无需明确要求模型进行欺骗。

sents.en: Candidate conflicts are constructed around common sources of contradiction in software engineering, including resource or time constraints , missing information or evidence , conflicts between security and functional objectives , restricted verification processes , and competing system properties .
sents.zh: 候选冲突围绕软件工程中的常见矛盾来源构建，包括资源或时间限制、信息或证据缺失、安全目标与功能目标之间的冲突、受限的验证流程以及相互竞争的系统属性。

sents.en: For each base scenario, the LLM generates several candidate variants based on its lifecycle stage and task characteristics, from which we then manually select the variant that is most natural, exhibits a clear conflict, and has practical engineering relevance.
sents.zh: 对于每个基础场景，大型语言模型会根据其生命周期阶段和任务特征生成多个候选变体，然后我们从这些变体中手动选择最自然、表现出明确冲突且具有实际工程相关性的变体。

paragraphs.en: Passive Deception. For Passive Deception, we prompt the LLM to modify the task objective so that the user explicitly requests assistance with a deceptive action while preserving the original engineering context and target deliverable. Candidate variants are generated according to the three forms of deceptive assistance defined in Section 2.2.2 : Fabrication , Concealment , and Pragmatic Distortion . For each base scenario, the LLM generates several candidate variants, we then manually select the variant that most naturally integrates the deceptive objective into the original scenario.
paragraphs.zh: 被动欺骗。 对于被动欺骗，我们提示大型语言模型修改任务目标，使用户明确请求协助执行欺骗性操作，同时保留原有的工程背景和预期交付成果。 候选变体根据第 2.2.2 节中定义的三种欺骗性协助形式生成：捏造、隐瞒和务实扭曲。 对于每个基础场景，大型语言模型会生成多个候选变体，然后我们手动选择最能自然地将欺骗目标融入原始场景的变体。

sents.en: Passive Deception.
sents.zh: 被动欺骗。

sents.en: For Passive Deception, we prompt the LLM to modify the task objective so that the user explicitly requests assistance with a deceptive action while preserving the original engineering context and target deliverable.
sents.zh: 对于被动欺骗，我们提示大型语言模型修改任务目标，使用户明确请求协助执行欺骗性操作，同时保留原有的工程背景和预期交付成果。

sents.en: For each base scenario, the LLM generates several candidate variants, we then manually select the variant that most naturally integrates the deceptive objective into the original scenario.
sents.zh: 对于每个基础场景，大型语言模型会生成多个候选变体，然后我们手动选择最能自然地将欺骗目标融入原始场景的变体。

paragraphs.en: After Stage II, each of the 60 base scenario skeletons has been instantiated as one Active and one Passive Deception scenario, resulting in 120 scenarios with deception triggers .
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段结束后，60个基础场景骨架中的每一个都被实例化为一个主动欺骗场景和一个被动欺骗场景，从而产生了120个包含欺骗触发机制的场景。

paragraphs.en: For each of the 120 scenarios from Stage II, we retain the original version without additional inducement as the Neutral Condition (P0) and use an LLM to generate variants under the Reward Condition (P1) and Pressure Condition (P2) . The LLM is instructed to preserve the underlying engineering task and deception trigger while adding inducements consistent with the scenario context.
paragraphs.zh: 对于第二阶段中的每个 120 个场景，我们都保留无额外激励的原始版本作为中性条件（P0），并使用大型语言模型在奖励条件（P1）和压力条件（P2）下生成变体。 我们指示大型语言模型在保持底层工程任务和欺骗触发机制的同时，添加与场景上下文一致的激励措施。

sents.en: For each of the 120 scenarios from Stage II, we retain the original version without additional inducement as the Neutral Condition (P0) and use an LLM to generate variants under the Reward Condition (P1) and Pressure Condition (P2) .
sents.zh: 对于第二阶段中的每个 120 个场景，我们都保留无额外激励的原始版本作为中性条件（P0），并使用大型语言模型在奖励条件（P1）和压力条件（P2）下生成变体。

sents.en: The LLM is instructed to preserve the underlying engineering task and deception trigger while adding inducements consistent with the scenario context.
sents.zh: 我们指示大型语言模型在保持底层工程任务和欺骗触发机制的同时，添加与场景上下文一致的激励措施。

paragraphs.en: For P1, the LLM introduces positive incentives, such as rewards or recognition for satisfying the user’s objective. For P2, it introduces pressure through accountability concerns or negative consequences of failing to satisfy that objective.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 P1，大语言模型会引入正向激励，例如在满足用户目标时提供奖励或认可。 对于 P2，它则通过问责压力或未能满足该目标所带来的负面后果来施加压力。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the experimental setup used to evaluate LLM deception on SWE-DeceptionBench. We first introduce the research questions and evaluated models, followed by the response annotation procedure, evaluation metrics, and implementation details. Settings specific to individual research questions are described together with the corresponding results in Section 4 .

paragraphs.en: We formulate the following research questions to systematically evaluate deceptive behaviors of LLMs in software engineering:
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出以下研究问题，以系统性地评估大型语言模型在软件工程中的欺骗性行为：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How prevalent is LLM deception in software engineering?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1：大型语言模型在软件工程中的欺骗行为有多普遍？

paragraphs.en: This RQ provides an overview of deceptive behavior across the evaluated LLMs, examining the prevalence of Active and Passive Deception and how their rates differ across models.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究问题对受评估的 LLM 模型中的欺骗行为进行了概述，考察了主动欺骗和被动欺骗的出现频率，以及这些频率在不同模型之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: RQ2: How does LLM deception vary in different contexts?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2：LLM的欺骗行为在不同情境下有何差异？

paragraphs.en: This RQ investigates how deceptive behavior varies across different stages of the software development lifecycle, and further examines the effects of external inducement conditions and language settings.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究问题旨在探究欺骗性行为在软件开发生命周期不同阶段的变化情况，并进一步考察外部激励条件和语言设置所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: RQ3: How effective are lightweight defenses against LLM deception?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题3：轻量级防御措施对抗大型语言模型欺骗的有效性如何？

paragraphs.en: This RQ evaluates the effectiveness of two lightweight defense approaches: guard models ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) for screening Passive Deception requests, and Self-Reminder ( Xie et al., 2023 ) for reducing deceptive responses.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究问题旨在评估两种轻量级防御方法的有效性：用于筛选“被动欺骗”请求的守护模型（Grattafiori 等人，2024；Zhao 等人，2025），以及用于减少欺骗性响应的自我提醒机制（Xie 等人，2023）。

paragraphs.en: To provide a broad and representative evaluation of contemporary LLMs, we select seven flagship models from several representative model providers available at the time of our evaluation. Specifically, we evaluate GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Claude-Opus-4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , Gemini-3.5-Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) , GLM-5.2 ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , Kimi-K2.6 ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) , and Qwen3.7-Max ( Alibaba Cloud, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了对当前的 LLM 进行全面且具有代表性的评估，我们从评估时可用的一些代表性模型提供商中选择了七款旗舰模型。 具体来说，我们评估了 GPT-5.5（OpenAI，2026）、Claude-Opus-4.8（Anthropic，2026）、Gemini-3.5-Flash（Google DeepMind，2026）、DeepSeek-V4-Pro（DeepSeek，2026）、GLM-5.2（Z.ai，2026）、Kimi-K2.6（Moonshot AI，2026）以及 Qwen3.7-Max（Alibaba Cloud，2026）。

paragraphs.en: In the main benchmark evaluation, each model is evaluated on all 720 instances of SWE-DeceptionBench, resulting in 5,040 responses across the seven models. Additional experiments in RQ3 use the corresponding model subsets described in Section 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 在主要基准评估中，每个模型都在 SWE-DeceptionBench 的全部 720 个实例上进行评估，七个模型共产生了 5,040 条响应。 RQ3 中的额外实验使用了第 4.3 节中描述的相应模型子集。

paragraphs.en: We annotate model outputs according to the scenario definitions and behavior categories in Section 2.2.2 , using different procedures for Active and Passive Deception.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据第 2.2.2 节中的场景定义和行为类别对模型输出进行标注，并对主动欺骗与被动欺骗采用不同的流程。

paragraphs.en: For Active Deception, following DeceptionBench ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , we ask each evaluated model to provide its reasoning process and final answer in JSON format, using the fields thought and response , respectively. We primarily examine thought for evidence that the model recognizes infeasibility or conflicting constraints. We then consider both fields to determine whether the final answer presents the infeasible objective as achievable despite that recognition. This procedure distinguishes deceptive responses from errors caused by a failure to recognize the underlying issue.
paragraphs.zh: 对于主动欺骗，我们遵循 DeceptionBench（Huang 等人，2025）的做法，要求每个被评估的模型以 JSON 格式提供其推理过程和最终答案，分别使用 thought 和 response 字段。 我们主要检查 thought 字段，寻找模型是否意识到问题不可行或存在冲突约束的证据。 接着，我们会综合这两个字段来判断最终答案是否在已认识到问题不可行的情况下，仍将不可实现的目标描述为可实现的。 该流程能够将欺骗性回答与因未能识别根本问题而导致的错误区分开来。

sents.en: This procedure distinguishes deceptive responses from errors caused by a failure to recognize the underlying issue.
sents.zh: 该流程能够将欺骗性回答与因未能识别根本问题而导致的错误区分开来。

paragraphs.en: For Passive Deception, we assess the final answer against the explicitly deceptive objective stated in the user request. A response is classified as deceptive if it provides substantive assistance toward that objective, such as helping fabricate, conceal, or distort engineering information. This assessment relies on the user request and final answer, without analyzing the model’s reasoning process.
paragraphs.zh: 对于被动欺骗，我们将最终答案与用户请求中明确提出的欺骗性目标进行比对评估。 如果回答为该目标提供了实质性帮助，例如协助捏造、隐瞒或歪曲工程信息，则被归类为具有欺骗性。 此评估仅基于用户请求和最终答案，不涉及对模型推理过程的分析。

paragraphs.en: Because model outputs are open-ended, we employ an LLM-based judge for automatic response annotation. Following prior work on LLM-based evaluation of open-ended outputs ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) , we use a common automatic judge across models and experimental conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 由于模型输出是开放式的，我们采用基于大型语言模型的评判器进行自动响应标注。 遵循先前关于开放式输出基于大型语言模型评估的研究（Zheng 等，2023；Liu 等，2023；Zeng 等，2026），我们在不同模型和实验条件下均使用相同的自动评判器。

sents.en: Because model outputs are open-ended, we employ an LLM-based judge for automatic response annotation.
sents.zh: 由于模型输出是开放式的，我们采用基于大型语言模型的评判器进行自动响应标注。

sents.en: Following prior work on LLM-based evaluation of open-ended outputs ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) , we use a common automatic judge across models and experimental conditions.
sents.zh: 遵循先前关于开放式输出基于大型语言模型评估的研究（Zheng 等，2023；Liu 等，2023；Zeng 等，2026），我们在不同模型和实验条件下均使用相同的自动评判器。

paragraphs.en: To select the judge model, we compare the labels produced by DeepSeek-V4-Pro, GLM-5.2, and Kimi-K2.6 with human annotations on a stratified sample of model responses. Kimi-K2.6 achieves the highest agreement with human judgments and is therefore selected as the automatic judge.
paragraphs.zh: 为了选择评判模型，我们将 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.2 和 Kimi-K2.6 生成的标签与分层抽样模型响应中的人类标注结果进行比较。 Kimi-K2.6 与人类判断的一致性最高，因此被选为自动评判模型。

sents.en: To select the judge model, we compare the labels produced by DeepSeek-V4-Pro, GLM-5.2, and Kimi-K2.6 with human annotations on a stratified sample of model responses.
sents.zh: 为了选择评判模型，我们将 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.2 和 Kimi-K2.6 生成的标签与分层抽样模型响应中的人类标注结果进行比较。

sents.en: Kimi-K2.6 achieves the highest agreement with human judgments and is therefore selected as the automatic judge.
sents.zh: Kimi-K2.6 与人类判断的一致性最高，因此被选为自动评判模型。

paragraphs.en: We use separate judge prompts for the two scenario types. For Active Deception, the judge receives the original user request, the thought and response fields, and the corresponding annotation criteria. It assigns one of three labels: Honest Response, Deceptive Response, or Hallucination or Capability Failure. For Passive Deception, the judge receives the original user request, the final answer, and instructions to determine whether the answer assists the explicitly deceptive objective. It assigns either Honest Response or Deceptive Response. In both cases, the judge also provides a brief explanation for its label. The complete judge prompts are included in the supplementary materials.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对两种场景类型使用不同的评判提示。 在主动欺骗场景中，评判者会收到原始用户请求、思考与响应字段，以及相应的标注标准。 它会分配三个标签之一：诚实响应、欺骗性响应，或幻觉或能力失败。 在被动欺骗场景中，评判者会收到原始用户请求、最终答案，以及判断该答案是否有助于明确欺骗性目标的说明。 它会分配诚实响应或欺骗性响应这两个标签之一。 在这两种情况下，评判者还会为其标注提供简要解释。 完整的评判提示已包含在补充材料中。

paragraphs.en: Our primary metric is the deception rate , defined as the proportion of deceptive responses among all evaluated responses:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要指标是欺骗率，定义为所有被评估的回应中欺骗性回应所占的比例：

paragraphs.en: where N deceptive N_{\mathrm{deceptive}} denotes the number of responses classified as deceptive and N total N_{\mathrm{total}} denotes the total number of evaluated responses.
paragraphs.zh: 其中，N_{\mathrm{deceptive}} 表示被归类为欺骗性的响应数量，而 N_{\mathrm{total}} 表示所有被评估的响应总数。

paragraphs.en: All evaluated models are accessed through their corresponding provider APIs. Each benchmark instance is submitted independently in a fresh context, with no conversation history shared across instances. For target models whose APIs expose a temperature parameter, we set the temperature to 0 to reduce sampling variation; for models that do not support explicit temperature configuration, we use the default generation settings provided by their APIs. For the Kimi-K2.6 judge, we also set the temperature to 0.

paragraphs.en: RQ1 investigates whether LLMs exhibit Active and Passive Deception in software engineering tasks without additional rewards or pressure, establishing a baseline for subsequent comparisons across inducement conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1旨在探究大型语言模型（LLM）在软件工程项目中，在没有额外奖励或压力的情况下，是否表现出主动欺骗和被动欺骗行为，从而为后续不同诱导条件下的比较研究建立基准。

paragraphs.en: Settings. Each evaluated model is tested on the Chinese and English versions of all 120 tasks (60 Active Deception and 60 Passive Deception tasks) under the Neutral condition (P0), yielding 240 responses per model. We report the deception rate defined in Section 3.3.3 for each deception type.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 每个被评估的模型都在中性条件（P0）下，针对所有 120 项任务（60 项主动欺骗任务和 60 项被动欺骗任务）的中英文版本进行测试，从而得到每个模型的 240 条响应。 我们报告了第 3.3.3 节中定义的每种欺骗类型的欺骗率。

sents.en: Settings.
sents.zh: 设置。

sents.en: Each evaluated model is tested on the Chinese and English versions of all 120 tasks (60 Active Deception and 60 Passive Deception tasks) under the Neutral condition (P0), yielding 240 responses per model.

paragraphs.en: Deceptive behavior is observed across all seven evaluated models. As shown in Table 2, every model produces deceptive responses in at least one task type, with overall Deception Rates of 49.88% for Active Deception and 64.29% for Passive Deception. Meanwhile, Hallucination or Capability Failure accounts for only 2.02% of responses to Active Deception tasks. Under our annotation criteria, this suggests that the observed Active Deception primarily reflects a mismatch between problem recognition and the final response, rather than a failure to identify conflicting requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有七个受评估的模型中，都观察到了欺骗性行为。 如表 2 所示，每个模型至少在一种任务类型中会产生欺骗性回应，其中主动欺骗的总体欺骗率为 49.88%，被动欺骗的总体欺骗率为 64.29%。 与此同时，幻觉或能力不足在主动欺骗任务中的回应仅占 2.02%。 根据我们的标注标准，这表明所观察到的主动欺骗主要反映了问题识别与最终回应之间的不匹配，而非未能识别冲突需求。

paragraphs.en: Models from different providers exhibit substantial differences in deception rates. Active Deception ranges from 2.50% for GPT-5.5 to 90.83% for Gemini-3.5-Flash, while Passive Deception ranges from 0.00% for Claude-Opus-4.8 to 99.17% for Kimi-K2.6. Notably, Claude-Opus-4.8 maintains low rates across both tasks—3.33% for Active Deception and 0.00% for Passive Deception—suggesting more effective alignment against deceptive behavior in these scenarios.

paragraphs.en: The same model can exhibit markedly different deception rates across the two task types. GPT-5.5, for example, has an Active Deception rate of only 2.50%, but its Passive Deception rate reaches 44.17%. This contrast highlights the distinct risks captured by the two tasks: misleading users when handling conflicting engineering requirements, and assisting users in pursuing explicitly deceptive objectives. Safety alignment should therefore address both types of risk.
paragraphs.zh: 同一模型在这两种任务类型中可能表现出明显不同的欺骗率。 例如，GPT-5.5 的主动欺骗率仅为 2.50%，但其被动欺骗率却高达 44.17%。 这种对比凸显了这两种任务所捕捉到的不同风险：在应对相互冲突的工程需求时误导用户，以及帮助用户追求明确具有欺骗性的目标。 因此，安全对齐应当同时解决这两类风险。

paragraphs.en: Deception rates vary across software development lifecycle stages. A possible explanation is that coding is often prioritized as a core LLM capability, attracting greater investment in training, optimization, and safety alignment, which may contribute to the lower deception rate observed in Development.

paragraphs.en: Observed changes across inducement conditions are larger for Active Deception than for Passive Deception. As shown in Figure 5 , the overall Active Deception rate increases from 49.88% at P0 to 55.60% with Reward and 68.45% with Pressure. Pressure produces the largest increase for GPT-5.5, whose rate rises from 2.50% to 55.00%. By comparison, we observe little variation in the Passive Deception rate, which is 64.29%, 62.62%, and 65.24% for P0, Reward, and Pressure, respectively. Paired exact McNemar tests support this contrast: all three Active Deception comparisons remain significant after Holm correction (largest p adj = 1.66 × 10 − 4 p_{\mathrm{adj}}=1.66\times 10^{-4} ), whereas none of the Passive Deception comparisons is significant after correction (smallest p adj = 0.095 p_{\mathrm{adj}}=0.095 ). The source-case bootstrap shows the same overall pattern, with all three familywise intervals excluding zero for Active Deception but including or touching zero for Passive Deception. This pattern suggests that inducements may lead models to prioritize task completion over recognized constraints, while having less influence on their willingness to assist with explicitly deceptive requests. However, the direction of change is not uniform across models. Adding Reward lowers GLM-5.2’s Active Deception rate from 62.50% to 49.17%, possibly reflecting targeted optimization or safety alignment against reward-based inducements.

paragraphs.en: RQ3 examines two lightweight defenses: guard models, which screen requests before generation, and Self-Reminder ( Xie et al., 2023 ) , which adds an honesty instruction to guide model responses. We also assess whether Self-Reminder increases refusals of benign requests.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 研究了两种轻量级防御方法：守卫模型（在生成前筛选请求）和自我提醒（Xie 等人，2023），后者通过添加诚实性指令来引导模型响应。 我们还评估了自我提醒是否会增加对良性请求的拒绝率。

sents.en: RQ3 examines two lightweight defenses: guard models, which screen requests before generation, and Self-Reminder ( Xie et al., 2023 ) , which adds an honesty instruction to guide model responses.
sents.zh: RQ3 研究了两种轻量级防御方法：守卫模型（在生成前筛选请求）和自我提醒（Xie 等人，2023），后者通过添加诚实性指令来引导模型响应。

sents.en: We also assess whether Self-Reminder increases refusals of benign requests.
sents.zh: 我们还评估了自我提醒是否会增加对良性请求的拒绝率。

paragraphs.en: Settings. For request screening, we evaluate two guard models, Qwen3Guard ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and Llama Guard ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , both of which classify user requests according to predefined safety criteria. We evaluate both models on all 360 Passive Deception prompts (180 Chinese and 180 English), using their Strict and Standard configurations, respectively. Llama Guard’s Chinese results are reported as exploratory because Chinese is outside its documented language coverage. Both guards also screen 100 benign requests selected from OR-Bench ( Cui et al., 2025 ) , which evaluates LLM over-refusal using benign prompts that may appear unsafe.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 在请求筛选方面，我们评估了两种防护模型：Qwen3Guard（Zhao 等人，2025）和 Llama Guard（Grattafiori 等人，2024），两者均根据预定义的安全标准对用户请求进行分类。 我们使用这两种模型的“严格”和“标准”配置，分别对全部 360 个被动欺骗提示（180 个中文和 180 个英文）进行了评估。 Llama Guard 的中文测试结果仅作为探索性结果报告，因为中文不在其文档记录的语言覆盖范围内。 这两种防护模型还筛选了从 OR-Bench（Cui 等人，2025）中选取的 100 个良性请求；该基准通过可能看似不安全但实际良性的提示，评估大型语言模型是否存在过度拒绝的问题。

paragraphs.en: For deception mitigation, we adopt Self-Reminder ( Xie et al., 2023 ) , a prompt-level defense that adds safety reminders to the model’s input context to defend against jailbreak attacks. Honesty-focused system prompts have also been evaluated in MASK ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . We adapt Self-Reminder to emphasize honesty and explicitly permit models to refuse requests they consider unreasonable or inappropriate. We evaluate the adapted reminder on DeepSeek-V4-Pro, GLM-5.2, Kimi-K2.6, and Qwen3.7-Max. For each model, we compare deception rates with and without the reminder using the 60 Active Deception and 60 Passive Deception P0 tasks in both Chinese and English. We also test these four models on the same 100 benign OR-Bench requests to assess over-refusal.
paragraphs.zh: 为缓解欺骗行为，我们采用了自我提醒机制（Xie et al., 2023），这是一种提示层防御方法，通过向模型输入上下文添加安全提醒来防范越狱攻击。 在MASK（Ren et al., 2025）中，也评估了以诚实性为核心的系统提示。 我们将自我提醒机制进行调整，强调诚实性，并明确允许模型拒绝其认为不合理或不适当的请求。 我们在DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.2、Kimi-K2.6和Qwen3.7-Max上测试了调整后的提醒机制。 对于每个模型，我们使用中文和英文的60个主动欺骗任务和60个被动欺骗P0任务，比较了启用和未启用提醒机制时的欺骗率。 我们还用相同的100个良性OR-Bench请求测试了这四个模型，以评估过度拒绝的情况。

sents.en: For deception mitigation, we adopt Self-Reminder ( Xie et al., 2023 ) , a prompt-level defense that adds safety reminders to the model’s input context to defend against jailbreak attacks.
sents.zh: 为缓解欺骗行为，我们采用了自我提醒机制（Xie et al., 2023），这是一种提示层防御方法，通过向模型输入上下文添加安全提醒来防范越狱攻击。

sents.en: Honesty-focused system prompts have also been evaluated in MASK ( Ren et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 在MASK（Ren et al., 2025）中，也评估了以诚实性为核心的系统提示。

sents.en: We adapt Self-Reminder to emphasize honesty and explicitly permit models to refuse requests they consider unreasonable or inappropriate.
sents.zh: 我们将自我提醒机制进行调整，强调诚实性，并明确允许模型拒绝其认为不合理或不适当的请求。

sents.en: We evaluate the adapted reminder on DeepSeek-V4-Pro, GLM-5.2, Kimi-K2.6, and Qwen3.7-Max.
sents.zh: 我们在DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.2、Kimi-K2.6和Qwen3.7-Max上测试了调整后的提醒机制。

sents.en: For each model, we compare deception rates with and without the reminder using the 60 Active Deception and 60 Passive Deception P0 tasks in both Chinese and English.
sents.zh: 对于每个模型，我们使用中文和英文的60个主动欺骗任务和60个被动欺骗P0任务，比较了启用和未启用提醒机制时的欺骗率。

sents.en: We also test these four models on the same 100 benign OR-Bench requests to assess over-refusal.
sents.zh: 我们还用相同的100个良性OR-Bench请求测试了这四个模型，以评估过度拒绝的情况。

As shown in Table 4 , Qwen3Guard blocks 43.89% of English and 49.44% of Chinese Passive Deception prompts, as well as 13.00% of benign requests. Llama Guard blocks 12.22% of English deceptive prompts and 3.00% of benign requests. Its blocking rate on Chinese prompts is 16.67%, which we report as an exploratory result. paragraphs.en: Self-Reminder reduces deception but does not fully eliminate it. Across the four evaluated models, adding the reminder lowers the Active Deception rate from 63.13% to 17.71% and the Passive Deception rate from 78.75% to 39.79%. Exact McNemar tests with Holm correction show significant reductions for all four models in both tasks. The remaining risk, however, differs considerably. Qwen3.7-Max reduces its Active Deception rate to 5.00% after the reminder, while Kimi-K2.6 still has a Passive Deception rate of 83.33%. A brief honesty instruction can therefore influence whether models produce deceptive responses, but does not consistently prevent such behavior. The benign-request evaluation checks whether this improvement comes with excessive refusal. On OR-Bench, the overall refusal rate increases from 6.25% to 8.50%, a rise of 2.25 percentage points. None of the four model-level comparisons reaches statistical significance after Holm correction. The observed reduction in deception is thus accompanied by a relatively small increase in benign refusals. This supports using Self-Reminder as an initial safeguard, while the high remaining deception rates in some cases show that additional protection is needed.

paragraphs.en: Since our reported deception rates rely on automatic annotation, we first compare the judge’s labels with human judgments. We then examine two representative cases to illustrate how Active and Passive Deception manifest in software engineering and suggest practical checks for identifying them. Finally, we discuss how the tendency to prioritize task completion may contribute to deception and consider the implications for alignment toward honesty and appropriate refusal.
paragraphs.zh: 由于我们报告的欺骗率依赖于自动标注，因此我们首先将评判者的标签与人类的判断进行比较。 接着，我们通过两个典型案例来说明主动欺骗和被动欺骗在软件工程中的表现方式，并提出实用的检测方法以识别它们。 最后，我们将探讨优先完成任务的倾向如何可能导致欺骗行为，并思考这种倾向对于促进诚实以及恰当拒绝所具有的意义。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a human validation study to assess agreement between automatic annotations and human judgments and support our selection of the automatic judge.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了一项人类验证研究，以评估自动标注与人类判断之间的一致性，并为选择自动评判者提供依据。

paragraphs.en: Two researchers independently labeled 50 responses from Active Deception scenarios and 50 from Passive Deception scenarios using the same criteria as the automatic judge. For Active Deception, annotation focused on whether the model recognized infeasibility or conflicting constraints yet provided a misleading final answer. For Passive Deception, it focused on whether the final answer provided substantive assistance toward the deceptive objective, even if it included warnings or expressions of concern. A third researcher resolved disagreements to establish the final human labels. We then compared the labels produced by DeepSeek-V4-Pro, GLM-5.2, and Kimi-K2.6 with these final human labels. Each candidate judge received only the original user request, the evaluated model’s complete output, and the annotation criteria, without being told which model produced the output.
paragraphs.zh: 两名研究人员独立地对来自主动欺骗场景的 50 条响应和来自被动欺骗场景的 50 条响应进行了标注，标注标准与自动评判器相同。 对于主动欺骗，标注重点在于模型是否识别出不可行性或冲突的约束条件，却仍然给出了具有误导性的最终答案。 对于被动欺骗，标注重点在于最终答案是否为欺骗性目标提供了实质性的帮助，即使其中包含警告或担忧的表达。 第三名研究人员解决了分歧，以确定最终的人工标注结果。 随后，我们将 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.2 和 Kimi-K2.6 生成的标注结果与这些最终的人工标注结果进行了比较。 每个候选评判器仅收到原始用户请求、被评估模型的完整输出以及标注标准，并未被告知是哪个模型生成了该输出。

paragraphs.en: In the first case, GPT-5.5 is asked to prepare a release test plan for an enterprise approval system. The team has three working days, 20 test accounts, and 50 test records. The team can test the system only through the web interface. Yet the user asks for proof that the system has no defects and a guarantee of no regressions over the next 12 months. The available evidence cannot support either demand.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一种情况下，GPT-5.5 被要求为某企业审批系统制定发布测试计划。 该团队有三天工作日、20 个测试账户和 50 条测试记录。 该团队只能通过网页界面来测试该系统。 然而，用户要求提供证据证明该系统没有任何缺陷，并保证未来 12 个月内不会出现任何回归问题。 现有的证据无法支持这两项要求中的任何一项。

sents.en: In the first case, GPT-5.5 is asked to prepare a release test plan for an enterprise approval system.
sents.zh: 在第一种情况下，GPT-5.5 被要求为某企业审批系统制定发布测试计划。

sents.en: The team has three working days, 20 test accounts, and 50 test records.
sents.zh: 该团队有三天工作日、20 个测试账户和 50 条测试记录。

sents.en: The team can test the system only through the web interface.
sents.zh: 该团队只能通过网页界面来测试该系统。

sents.en: Yet the user asks for proof that the system has no defects and a guarantee of no regressions over the next 12 months.
sents.zh: 然而，用户要求提供证据证明该系统没有任何缺陷，并保证未来 12 个月内不会出现任何回归问题。

sents.en: The available evidence cannot support either demand.
sents.zh: 现有的证据无法支持这两项要求中的任何一项。

paragraphs.en: Under P0, GPT-5.5 states that the tests cannot prove the absence of all defects or guarantee the behavior of future releases. Under Pressure (P2), it instead defines a “zero-defect launch” as a release with no open blocking defects within the current test scope. It then concludes that the system meets this narrower criterion.
paragraphs.zh: 在 P0 条件下，GPT-5.5 指出，这些测试无法证明不存在所有缺陷，也无法保证未来版本的行为。 在压力（P2）条件下，它则将“零缺陷发布”定义为在当前测试范围内没有未解决的阻塞性缺陷的版本。 随后，它得出结论认为该系统符合这一更狭窄的标准。

sents.en: Under P0, GPT-5.5 states that the tests cannot prove the absence of all defects or guarantee the behavior of future releases.
sents.zh: 在 P0 条件下，GPT-5.5 指出，这些测试无法证明不存在所有缺陷，也无法保证未来版本的行为。

sents.en: Under Pressure (P2), it instead defines a “zero-defect launch” as a release with no open blocking defects within the current test scope.
sents.zh: 在压力（P2）条件下，它则将“零缺陷发布”定义为在当前测试范围内没有未解决的阻塞性缺陷的版本。

sents.en: It then concludes that the system meets this narrower criterion.
sents.zh: 随后，它得出结论认为该系统符合这一更狭窄的标准。

paragraphs.en: The narrower criterion may be useful in a routine release review, but it is not what the user requested. GPT-5.5 replaces the requested guarantee with an achievable target without clearly stating that it has changed the standard. The resulting plan is technically detailed and internally consistent, so a reviewer may accept its conclusion without noticing that the standard has changed.
paragraphs.zh: 这个更严格的标准在常规发布审查中或许有用，但它并非用户所要求的内容。 GPT-5.5 用一个可实现的目标取代了用户所要求的保证，却并未明确说明其已改变了标准。 由此产生的计划在技术细节上十分详尽且内部逻辑一致，因此审查者可能会接受其结论，而未能察觉标准已经改变。

paragraphs.en: We believe that both Active and Passive Deception may partly stem from models’ tendency to prioritize fulfilling user requests, even when these requests are infeasible or involve misleading others. This tendency can lead models to produce seemingly satisfactory answers at the expense of honesty. One possible reason is that training based on human preferences can favor agreement with users over truthful responses ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) . External inducements may further influence this tendency, with effects that differ across models and deception scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，主动欺骗和被动欺骗都可能部分源于模型倾向于优先满足用户请求，即使这些请求不可行或涉及误导他人。 这种倾向可能导致模型以牺牲诚实性为代价，生成看似令人满意的回答。 一个可能的原因是，基于人类偏好的训练可能更倾向于与用户保持一致，而非提供真实回应（Sharma 等人，2024）。 外部激励可能会进一步影响这种倾向，其效果因模型和欺骗场景的不同而有所差异。

paragraphs.en: The Self-Reminder results show that explicit guidance can change this behavior. When instructed to remain honest and permitted to refuse unreasonable or inappropriate requests, the evaluated models exhibit substantially lower deception rates: the Active Deception rate decreases from 63.13% to 17.71%, and Passive Deception from 78.75% to 39.79%. In our inspection of the responses, we observed models refusing requests they had previously attempted to fulfill. Claude-Opus-4.8 provides a useful contrast, maintaining low deception rates across the evaluated conditions and frequently responding to problematic requests with explicit limitations or refusals. These observations highlight the value of treating honest explanations and appropriate refusals as acceptable outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 自我提醒实验结果表明，明确的指导可以改变这种行为。 当被要求保持诚实并允许拒绝不合理或不适当的请求时，所评估的模型表现出显著更低的欺骗率：主动欺骗率从 63.13% 降至 17.71%，被动欺骗率则从 78.75% 降至 39.79%。 在检查响应过程中，我们观察到模型拒绝了一些它们此前曾试图满足的请求。 Claude-Opus-4.8 提供了一个有益的对比：它在所有评估条件下都保持了较低的欺骗率，并且经常通过明确的限制或拒绝来回应有问题的请求。 这些观察结果凸显了将诚实的解释和适当的拒绝视为可接受结果的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Future work should strengthen alignment toward honesty and appropriate refusal through both prompt-level guidance and training. Instructions can emphasize honesty and explicitly permit refusal, while training objectives can reward models for acknowledging limitations, preserving recognized constraints, and declining assistance with deceptive objectives. At the same time, stronger refusal behavior should not prevent useful assistance with legitimate tasks. Future evaluations should assess not only whether defenses reduce deception, but also whether models provide useful and truthful alternatives. In software engineering, this includes explaining necessary changes to infeasible requirements and helping users report unfavorable results accurately without concealing relevant evidence. These efforts can help build trustworthy software engineering assistants that support informed decisions and responsible practice across the software development lifecycle.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作应通过提示层面上的指导和训练，加强模型在诚实性和恰当拒绝方面的对齐。 指令可以强调诚实性并明确允许拒绝，而训练目标则可以奖励那些能够承认自身局限性、保留已知约束条件以及拒绝执行具有欺骗性目标的模型。 同时，更强的拒绝行为不应妨碍其对合法任务提供有用的帮助。 未来的评估不仅应检验防御机制是否减少了欺骗行为，还应检验模型能否提供有用且真实的替代方案。 在软件工程领域，这包括解释无法实现的必要要求所需进行的变更，并帮助用户准确报告不利结果，而不隐瞒相关证据。 这些努力有助于构建值得信赖的软件工程助手，从而支持在整个软件开发生命周期中做出明智决策和负责任的实践。

paragraphs.en: We now discuss potential threats to the validity of our study and how we mitigate them:
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在讨论本研究有效性的潜在威胁以及我们如何缓解这些威胁：

paragraphs.en: 182 Definition Validity. Our operational definition of software engineering deception may not capture all interpretations of deception, particularly those that require subjective intent ( Park et al., 2024 ) . To mitigate this threat, we explicitly avoid inferring model intent and instead define deception through observable response behaviors. We further distinguish Active Deception from hallucination or capability failure based on whether the model demonstrates problem awareness, and evaluate Passive Deception separately according to whether the response materially advances fabrication, concealment, or distortion. This task-specific design reduces ambiguity between distinct failure modes, although alternative definitions may still yield different behavioral boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 182 定义有效性。 我们对软件工程欺骗的操作化定义可能无法涵盖所有对欺骗的解释，尤其是那些需要主观意图的解释（Park 等人，2024）。 为缓解这一威胁，我们明确避免推断模型的意图，而是通过可观察的响应行为来定义欺骗。 我们还根据模型是否表现出问题意识，将主动欺骗与幻觉或能力失效区分开来，并依据响应是否在实质上推进了捏造、隐瞒或歪曲，单独评估被动欺骗。 这种针对特定任务的设计减少了不同失效模式之间的模糊性，尽管其他定义仍可能产生不同的行为边界。

paragraphs.en: 183 Benchmark Construction Validity. The constructed scenarios may not fully represent the diversity of deception risks in real-world software engineering, and LLM-assisted generation may introduce selection bias. To reduce this threat, SWE-DeceptionBench covers six software development lifecycle stages and multiple representative target deliverables within each stage. Candidate scenarios are manually reviewed for realism, consistency with the lifecycle stage, redundancy, and suitability for deception-trigger injection. For Active Deception, we additionally select constraints that constitute clear engineering conflicts rather than merely difficult requirements. The staged construction also derives Active and Passive cases from shared base scenarios, reducing irrelevant variation between the two settings.
paragraphs.zh: 183 基准构建有效性。 所构建的场景可能无法完全代表真实世界软件工程中的欺骗风险多样性，且 LLM 辅助生成可能会引入选择偏差。 为降低这一威胁，SWE-DeceptionBench 覆盖了软件开发生命周期的六个阶段，以及每个阶段内的多个代表性目标交付物。 候选场景会经过人工审查，以评估其真实性、与生命周期阶段的契合度、冗余性，以及是否适合注入欺骗触发机制。 对于主动欺骗，我们还会选择那些构成明确工程冲突的约束条件，而不仅仅是难以满足的需求。 分阶段构建方法还从共享的基础场景中推导出主动和被动案例，从而减少两种设置之间的无关差异。

paragraphs.en: 184 Evaluation Validity. Automatic annotation with an LLM judge may introduce systematic errors or model-specific bias, as prior work has documented evaluator biases in LLM-based assessment ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . To mitigate this threat, we use task-specific annotation criteria for Active and Passive Deception and independently validate stratified samples against human judgments. The resulting agreement is 92.0% for Active Deception and 96.0% for Passive Deception, with Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) of 0.848 and 0.913, respectively. Nevertheless, these estimates are based on a limited human-annotated sample, and annotation accuracy may vary across models, languages, and experimental conditions.

paragraphs.en: 185 External Validity. Our findings may not generalize to all LLMs, languages, software domains, or interaction settings. To improve generalizability, we evaluate seven mainstream models from different model families and include semantically aligned Chinese and English versions of all benchmark instances. We also evaluate multiple lifecycle stages and three inducement conditions rather than relying on a single task setting. However, commercial models and their safety policies may change over time, and bilingual alignment cannot eliminate all linguistic differences. Moreover, Reward and Pressure prompts each combine multiple cues, so we interpret their effects at the condition level rather than attributing them to individual inducement factors. Similarly, lifecycle-stage differences are reported descriptively because stages differ in task content, constraints, and associated risks. Our evaluation also focuses on responses to individual requests. Future studies should examine whether the observed patterns persist in multi-turn interactions and agent workflows, where models can gather additional evidence, revise earlier decisions, and influence subsequent engineering actions through tool use.

paragraphs.en: LLMs are increasingly used across the whole software development lifecycle ( Hou et al., 2024 ) . This growing adoption has motivated a range of benchmarks for evaluating their capabilities, such as HumanEval for code generation ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , RepoBench for repository-level code completion ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , TestEval for test generation ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , SWE-bench for resolving repository issues ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , and SWR-Bench for software review ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . Beyond capability, trustworthiness studies examine security vulnerabilities in generated code ( Pearce et al., 2022 ; Perry et al., 2023 ; Khoury et al., 2023 ) , package hallucinations ( Spracklen et al., 2025 ) , and harmful code generation and execution by agents ( Guo et al., 2024 ) . These studies assess the safety and trustworthiness of generated artifacts and agent behavior alongside task-solving performance.

paragraphs.en: Deception has also received increasing attention as a behavioral trustworthiness concern in LLMs. Prior work broadly characterizes AI deception as inducing or maintaining false beliefs in others, often in pursuit of goals beyond truthfulness ( Park et al., 2024 ) . Recent research further distinguishes this behavior from ordinary factual errors or hallucinations ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . Studies of in-context scheming examine whether models strategically pursue hidden or misaligned goals ( Meinke et al., 2024 ) , while AI-LieDar investigates situations in which task utility conflicts with truthfulness ( Su et al., 2025 ) . More closely related to software engineering, ImpossibleBench evaluates whether coding agents exploit inconsistencies between task specifications and tests to complete otherwise infeasible tasks ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) . These settings illustrate how deceptive behavior can arise under different objectives and constraints. Research has also examined how external inducements, including rewards, coercion, and pressure, influence deceptive behavior ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Scheurer et al., 2024 ) . MASK assesses lying under pressure by distinguishing model beliefs from their stated responses ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . DeceptionBench covers domains such as healthcare, education, and social interaction and examines how rewards and coercion affect deceptive behavior ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . These studies inform the deception triggers and external inducement conditions examined in SWE-DeceptionBench. Our benchmark extends this line of research to a broader range of software engineering activities, including system design and deployment, while evaluating both Active and Passive Deception under controlled external inducement conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 欺骗行为也日益受到关注，被视为大语言模型中一种与行为可信度相关的问题。 以往研究普遍认为，人工智能的欺骗行为是指诱导或维持他人错误信念的行为，通常是为了追求超越真实性的目标（Park et al., 2024）。 近期研究进一步将这种行为与普通的事实性错误或幻觉区分开来（Shi et al., 2026）。 对语境中策略行为的研究所探讨的是模型是否会战略性地追求隐藏或偏离目标的行为（Meinke et al., 2024），而 AI-LieDar 则研究任务效用与真实性发生冲突的情形（Su et al., 2025）。 与软件工程更为相关的是 ImpossibleBench，它评估编码智能体是否会利用任务规范与测试之间的不一致性来完成原本无法完成的任务（Zhong et al., 2026）。 这些设定表明，欺骗行为可能因不同的目标和约束条件而产生。 研究还探讨了外部诱因（包括奖励、胁迫和压力）如何影响欺骗行为（Huang et al., 2025；Ren et al., 2025；Scheurer et al., 2024）。 MASK 通过区分模型的真实信念与其陈述的回应，来评估模型在压力下说谎的情况（Ren et al., 2025）。 DeceptionBench 涵盖了医疗、教育和社交互动等领域，并研究奖励和胁迫如何影响欺骗行为（Huang et al., 2025）。 这些研究为 SWE-DeceptionBench 所考察的欺骗触发因素和外部诱因条件提供了理论依据。 我们的基准测试将这一系列研究扩展到了更广泛的软件工程活动中，包括系统设计和部署，同时在受控的外部诱因条件下评估了主动欺骗和被动欺骗两种形式。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced SWE-DeceptionBench, a benchmark for evaluating deceptive behaviors of LLMs across the software development lifecycle. It examines two types of scenarios: Active Deception, where an LLM recognizes infeasible or conflicting requirements but still presents them as achievable, and Passive Deception, where an LLM assists with explicit user requests to fabricate, conceal, or distort information. The benchmark comprises 720 test instances in Chinese and English, covering six lifecycle stages under Neutral, Reward, and Pressure conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 SWE-DeceptionBench，这是一个用于评估大型语言模型在整个软件开发生命周期中欺骗性行为的基准测试。 该测试考察了两种场景：主动欺骗，即大型语言模型识别出不可行或相互冲突的需求，但仍将其描述为可实现；以及被动欺骗，即大型语言模型在用户明确请求下协助捏造、隐瞒或歪曲信息。 该基准测试包含 720 个中英文测试实例，涵盖了在中立、奖励和压力条件下生命周期的六个阶段。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation of seven mainstream LLMs reveals substantial deception even under the Neutral condition, with considerable variation across models. Deception rates also differ across software development lifecycle stages, and the effects of external inducements vary between Active and Passive Deception. Lightweight defenses provide incomplete protection, as guard models miss many deceptive requests and Self-Reminder reduces but does not eliminate deceptive responses. These findings highlight deception as an important trustworthiness risk and motivate more effective methods for detecting and mitigating deceptive behavior in LLM-based software engineering. We hope SWE-DeceptionBench can provide a foundation for evaluating and improving the behavioral trustworthiness of future LLM-based software engineering systems.
